mathematical_contract.whole_carrier: For homogeneous C(t)=(X(t),Y(t),W(t)), both affine equality equations X(t)W(u)-W(t)X(u)=0 and Y(t)W(u)-W(t)Y(u)=0 are divided exactly by the universal u-t component before elimination.
mathematical_contract.symmetric_projection: The divided whole-carrier system is symmetric, so one complete parameter-axis projection is cloned for the other axis; exact replay considers only t<u before constructing affine point evidence.
mathematical_contract.retained_subranges: For retained source maps s1(t)=a1+d1*t and s2(u)=a2+d2*u, both equality equations are divided exactly by s2(u)-s1(t). The residual system supplies all off-correspondence contacts, while touching source endpoints and positive-length source-range overlap are retained independently.
mathematical_contract.contact_replay: No resultant root becomes topology until exact affine point replay succeeds. Same-source pairs are removed by exact affine algebraic-parameter comparison, not by finite sampling.
mathematical_contract.transversality: The homogeneous affine derivative numerators Dx=X'W-XW' and Dy=Y'W-YW' form an exact bivariate tangent-cross polynomial; refined Bernstein sign proof retains orientation for both whole-carrier and related-subrange contacts.
mathematical_contract.composite_result: RationalBezierIntersectionContacts2::ContactsAndOverlap represents the complete case where a positive-length same-source image and isolated cross-branch contacts coexist; top-level CurveIntersectionResult2 publishes both collections.
mathematical_contract.failure_semantics: A remaining positive-dimensional divided residual, unsupported coefficient division, or incomplete overlap-plus-residual replay remains an explicit degenerate or policy blocker; it is never reported as an empty contact set.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 construct and replay identical exact equations and return identical exact geometry. APPROXIMATE_512 may differ only where the inherited 512-bit equality terminal is consumed.
